tasks.title: Keep global surface titles clear of native window controls
tasks.objective: Give Focus and Tasks titlebars the same native control inset used by the existing window chrome.
tasks.outcome: With the Project Rail absent, the top-left title begins after the macOS traffic lights and stays readable across surface switching.
acceptance: Focus and Tasks global titlebars reserve the native-control area while Workspaces keeps its current rail and dock behavior.
The inset is declared in the shared chrome and is not duplicated inside either global content panel.
A focused titlebar test turns red when the global inset or its production class wiring is removed; the installed UI shows no overlap.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/traffic-light-inset.test.ts test/global-titlebar-inset.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1
